# iliad-051 (8.469–565) — new renderings

Rows are in the format of the conventions table: Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose.

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἐΰθρονος Ἠώς (ἐΰθρονον Ἠῶ, 8.565) | "fine-throned Dawn" | "fine-throned Dawn" (+ note: θρόνα "flowers" is an old alternative; sense not certain) | "well-seated", "fair-throned", "golden-throned" (reserved for χρυσόθρονος); ἐΰ- "fine" as in the table's ἐυπλόκαμος "fine-plaited" |
| ἀλεγίζω · ἀλέγω (οὐκ ἀλεγίζω, 8.477; οὔ … ἀλέγω, 8.483, with the genitive) | "take no heed of" | "take no heed of" / "heed" | "care for" (too soft), "reck", "mind", "regard"; "grievous" stays for ἀλεγεινός |
| κύντερον ἄλλο (8.483) | "more dog-like" | "more shameless" | follows the Odyssey's κύντερον "more dog-like" / "more shameless" unchanged |
| σκυζομένης (8.483) | "being sullen" | "in your sullenness" | "angry" (reserved for χόλος), "furious"; follows σκυζομένη "sullen toward" (4.23) |
| χωομένης (8.478) | "being incensed" | "in your anger" | "enraged"; χώομαι "be incensed" (4.357); the noun-like "anger" in `i` is the context's, not χόλος |
| ὄβριμος Ἕκτωρ (8.473) | "mighty Hector" | "mighty Hector" | follows ὄβριμος "mighty" (5.845) |
| ποδώκης Πηλεΐων (8.474) | "fleet-footed Peleus’-son" | "fleet-footed son of Peleus" | "swift of foot" (πόδας ὠκύς), "swift-footed" (ποδάρκης); follows ποδώκης "fleet-footed" (2.764) |
| στεῖνος ἐν αἰνοτάτῳ (8.476) | "in a most dread narrow place" | "in a most dreadful narrow place" | "tightest", "most terrible", "most fearsome"; follows αἰνότατε "most dread" / "most dreadful" (1.552); στεῖνος "narrow place" |
| νείατα πείραθα (8.478) | "the lowest limits" | "the lowest limits" | "furthest", "last"; πείρατα "limits" as in ὀλέθρου πείραθα (6.143) |
| αὐγή of the sun (αὐγῇς Ὑπερίονος Ἠελίοιο, 8.480) | "the rays of Hyperion the Sun" | "the rays of the Sun, Hyperion" | "glare" (kept for αὐγή of fire, 2.456), "beams", "light" (reserved for φάος); Ὑπερίων Ἠέλιος per the Odyssey table |
| τέρπομαι (τέρποντ’, 8.481) | "take delight" | "take delight" | "enjoy", "are cheered"; follows τέρποντο "were taking delight" (2.774) |
| ἀσπασίη τρίλλιστος … νύξ (8.488) | "welcome, thrice-prayed-for, night" | "night, murky and welcome, much prayed for" (+ note: τρι- may only be intensive) | "longed-for", "thrice-desired", "wished-for"; ἀσπάσιος "welcome" (the table's "a welcome sight"); ἐρεβεννή "murky" (5.659) |
| ἀέκων (Τρωσὶν … ἀέκουσιν, 8.487) | "unwilling" | "against their will" | "reluctant", "unwillingly" in `l`; ἀέκων "unwilling" (the Odyssey ἀέκοντι "unwilling") |
| ἐν καθαρῷ … νεκύων διεφαίνετο χῶρος (8.491) | "in a clear place, where of the dead showed through the ground" | "to a clear place where the ground showed through, free of the dead" (+ note: or "among the dead") | "an open space among the corpses" (picks the other sense), "a place clean of corpses" |
| ἐξ ἵππων … ἀποβάντες (8.492) | "from their horses having stepped down" | "stepped down from their horses" | "from their chariots", "dismounted" (loses ἀποβαίνω "step down"); the horses stand for the chariot-teams |
| ἑνδεκάπηχυ (ἔγχος, 8.494) | "eleven-cubit" | "eleven cubits long" | follows the table’s ἑνδεκάπηχυ (6.319) unchanged |
| ἐρεισάμενος (8.496) | "leaning" (on it) | "leaning on it" | "supporting himself", "propping"; ἐρείδω "press, prop" |
| νῦν ἐφάμην … ἀπονοστήσειν (8.498–499) | "Now I said … to return" | "Just now I thought that … I would go back home" | "hoped" (kept for ἔλπομαι), "boasted"; φημί "say", the future infinitive gives "would"; νόστος in the note |
| πρὶν κνέφας ἦλθε (8.500) | "before darkness came" | "darkness came before that" | "night fell" (the table’s row for κνέφας avoids it), "dusk"; κνέφας "darkness" (1.475) |
| ὑπὲξ ὀχέων (8.504) | "from beneath the chariots" | "from the chariots" | "from the yoke" (that is ζυγόν), "from the cars"; ὄχεσφιν "chariot" (5.219) |
| καλλίτριχας ἵππους (8.503) | "fair-maned horses" | "fair-maned horses" | follows the Odyssey’s καλλίτριχες ἵπποι (3.475) unchanged |
| ἐδωδή of horses (παρὰ δέ σφισι βάλλετ’ ἐδωδήν, 8.504) | "food" | "food" | "fodder", "feed" (the note says it is fodder here) |
| ἴφια μῆλα (8.505, 8.545) | "stout flocks" | "stout flocks" | follows the Odyssey’s ἴφια μῆλα (11.108) unchanged |
| καρπαλίμως (8.506, 8.546) | "swiftly" | "swiftly" | "quickly" (kept for ὦκα, αἶψα), "speedily" (the Odyssey’s l, 12.166); follows the Iliad’s καρπαλίμως "swiftly" (2.168) |
| οἶνον … μελίφρονα οἰνίζεσθε / οἰνίζοντο (8.506, 8.546) | "honey-hearted wine … get for yourselves" / "they got for themselves" | "heart-sweetening wine … get yourselves" / "got themselves" | "honey-sweet", "bought" (7.472’s row avoids "bought wine"); follows the Odyssey’s μελίφρων and the Iliad’s οἰνίζομαι (7.472) |
| ἐπὶ δὲ ξύλα πολλὰ λέγεσθε / λέγοντο (8.507, 8.547) | "and wood in plenty gather" / "they gathered" | "and gather wood in plenty as well" | "pick up", "collect" (kept for ἀγείρω), "bring"; λέγω "gather", ἐπί "in addition" (tmesis) |
| ἠοῦς ἠριγενείης (8.508) | "early-born dawn" | "early-born dawn" | "rosy-fingered" (the separate ῥοδοδάκτυλος formula), "child of morning"; the Odyssey’s ἠριγένεια "early-born" |
| σέλας (8.509, 8.563) | "blaze" | "blaze" | "flash" (kept for the thunderbolt-flash of 8.75, "blazing flash"), "glare" (αὐγή), "gleam", "light" (φάος) |
| κάρη κομόωντες Ἀχαιοί (8.510) | "long-haired-of-head Achaeans" | "long-haired Achaeans" | the table’s row (7.442) unchanged |
| ἀσπουδί (8.512; ἀ- + σπουδή) | "without trouble" | "without trouble" | "without a struggle", "unhurried", "unscathed"; the sense follows the context and the note says so |
| ἕκηλος (8.512) | "at ease" | "at ease" | follows the Odyssey’s ἕκηλος (13.423) unchanged |
| βέλος πέσσῃ (8.513) | "digest a missile" | "have a missile to nurse" (+ note: the metaphor is cooking, the usual explanation "suffer from a wound") | "cook a wound", "brood over", "bear"; πέσσω "digest" as in γέρα πεσσέμεν (2.237) |
| στυγέῃσι (8.515) | "may hate" | "may hate" | "shrink from", "loathe", "dread" (the table’s avoided list for στυγέω) |
| παῖδας πρωθήβας · πολιοκροτάφους γέροντας (8.518) | "boys in first youth" · "grey-templed old men" | "boys in their first youth" · "old men grey at the temples" | "youths", "grey-haired" (loses κρόταφος "temple"), "adolescents" |
| λέξασθαι (8.519) | "lay themselves down" | "lie down" (+ note: take up quarters for the night) | "bivouac", "keep watch", "assemble" |
| θεόδμητος (πύργοι, 8.519) | "god-built" | "god-built" | "built by the gods", "divinely built", "god-made" |
| ἄστυ (8.517, 8.519, 8.522) | "town" | "town" | "city" (reserved for πόλις); follows ἄστυ "town" (2.801) |
| θηλύτεραι γυναῖκες (8.520) | "the female women" | "the womenfolk" (+ note: θηλύτεραι has no real comparison) | "the more female", "the weaker sex", "womankind" |
| φυλακὴ … ἔμπεδος (8.521) | "a watch … a firm one" | "a firm watch" | "steady", "unbroken"; ἔμπεδος "firm" as in ἔμπεδοι φρένες (6.352) |
| λόχος (8.522) | "ambush" | "ambush" | "an ambush party", "a trap", "liers-in-wait" |
| μεγαλήτορες Τρῶες (8.523) | "great-spirited Trojans" | "great-spirited Trojans" | the table’s μεγαλήτωρ "great-spirited" (9.109) unchanged |
| μῦθος … ὑγιής (8.524) | "the word … sound" | "this word … sound" | "healthy", "wholesome", "right"; ὑγιής "sound" |
| κύνας κηρεσσιφορήτους (8.527; hapax, sense not certain) | "dogs borne by the death-fates" | "dogs borne by the fates of death" (+ note: sense not certain) | "death-borne dogs", "fate-driven dogs", "plague-bearing dogs" (each decides the sense); κήρ "death-fate" / "fate of death" (4.11) |
| ὑπηοῖοι (8.530); πρῶϊ (8.530) | "at dawn" · "early in the morning" | "at daybreak" · "early in the morning" | "at first light", "at dawn" for πρῶϊ; ἠώς "dawn" stays for ἠώς |
| ἐγείρομεν ὀξὺν Ἄρηα (8.531) | "we shall rouse sharp Ares" | "we shall rouse keen battle" | follows the table’s ἐγείρομεν ὀξὺν Ἄρηα (4.352) unchanged |
| Τυδεΐδης κρατερὸς Διομήδης (8.532) | "the Tydeus’-son, strong Diomedes" | "the son of Tydeus, strong Diomedes" | "mighty", "valiant"; follows κρατερὸς Διομήδης "strong" (4.401) and the patronymic form of the Odyssey |
| ἔναρα βροτόεντα (8.534) | "bloody spoils" | "bloody spoils" | "gory", "blood-stained", "bloodied"; ἔναρα "spoils" (9.188) |
| ἀρετήν · διαείσεται (8.535; διαείσεται rare, sense not certain) | "his own excellence" · "will see through" | "his own excellence" · "will learn" (+ note: sense of διαείσεται not certain) | "prowess" (the note’s gloss), "worth", "valour"; ἀρετή "excellence" (Odyssey 8.237) |
| οὐτηθείς (8.537) | "stabbed" | "stabbed" | "wounded", "pierced"; οὐτάω "stab" (4.469) |
| ἤματα πάντα (8.539) | "for all my days" | "for all my days" | the Odyssey’s "all your days" with the person changed; "forever" avoided |
| ἀθάνατος καὶ ἀγήρως (8.539) | "immortal and ageless" | "immortal and ageless" | "deathless" (kept for ἄμβροτος), "unaging"; follows ἀγήρων ἀθανάτην τε (2.447) |
| κελαδέω (ἐπὶ δὲ Τρῶες κελάδησαν, 8.542) | "upon it … cried aloud" | "at that … cried aloud" | "shouted", "roared", "applauded" (each adds a sense not in the verb) |
| ἱδρώοντας (ἵππους, 8.543) | "sweating" | "sweating" | "steaming", "lathered"; ἱδρόω "sweat" (2.388) |
| ἅρμα · ἱμάς (παρ’ ἅρμασιν, ἱμάντεσσι, 8.544) | "chariots" · "straps" | "chariots" · "straps" | "thongs", "reins"; ἅρμα kept as "chariot" (the same as ὄχεα) |
| ἔρδω (ἔρδον … ἑκατόμβας, 8.548) | "were sacrificing … hecatombs" | "sacrificed … hecatombs" | "performed", "offered", "did"; ῥέζω of sacrifice is "sacrifice" (2.400), and ἔρδω is the same verb |
| τεληέσσας ἑκατόμβας (8.548) | "complete hecatombs" | "complete hecatombs" | the Odyssey’s τεληέσσας ἑκατόμβας (4.582) unchanged |
| κνίση (8.549) | "savour" | "savour" | follows the Iliad’s κνίση "savour" (1.317) |
| οὐρανὸν εἴσω (8.549) | "into heaven" | "into heaven" | "up to heaven", "to the sky"; οὐρανός "heaven" |
| δατέοντο (8.550) | "shared in" (negated: "had no share") | "took no share of" | "divided", "feasted on"; δατέομαι "divide among themselves" (1.368), here with the partitive genitive |
| ἀπήχθετο (8.551) | "had become hateful" | "had become hateful" | "was hated"; follows ἀπήχθετο "was hateful" (6.140) with the aorist's start marked by "had become" |
| μέγα φρονέοντες (8.553) | "thinking great things" | "with high thoughts" | "proud", "high-spirited", "boasting"; the English follows the participle without deciding the tone |
| εἴατο (8.554, 8.563) | "sat" | "sat" | "were seated", "waited"; εἴατο is an epic imperfect of ἧμαι |
| ἀριπρεπέα (ἄστρα, 8.556) | "outstanding" | "outstanding" | "conspicuous" (reserved for ἀριδείκετος), "brilliant", "distinguished"; follows ἀριπρεπής "outstanding" (the table's avoided lists at 2.483 and 5.2) |
| νήνεμος αἰθήρ (8.556) | "the aether … windless" | "the upper air … windless" | "still", "calm", "sky"; αἰθήρ "upper air" in `i` (2.412) |
| σκοπιαί · πρώονες · νάπαι (8.557–558) | "lookout-peaks" · "headlands" · "dells" | "lookout peaks" · "headlands" · "dells" | "mountain-tops", "ridges", "glens" (kept for βῆσσα), "valleys"; each is a point of the landscape the note names |
| ἄσπετος (αἰθήρ, 8.558) | "boundless" | "boundless" | follows ἄσπετος "boundless" (Odyssey 14.412) |
| γέγηθε δέ τε φρένα ποιμήν (8.559) | "glad in his wits is the shepherd" | "the shepherd is glad in his mind" | "glad at heart" (κῆρ), "rejoices"; φρήν "wits" in `l`, "mind" in `i` |
| τόσσα … πυρά (8.560) | "So many … the fires" | "So many were the fires" | "such", "as many"; τόσσος "so many" |
| Ξάνθοιο ῥοάων (8.560) | "the streams of Xanthus" | "the streams of Xanthus" | "currents", "waters", "eddies" (kept for δίνη); ῥοαί "streams" |
| Ἰλιόθι πρό (8.561) | "before Ilios" | "before Ilios" | "Ilium"; Ἴλιον / Ἰλιόθι keep "Ilios" as in Ἴλιον εἰς εὔπωλον (5.551) beside Ἴλιος ἱρή "sacred Ilium" |
| κρῖ λευκόν · ὀλύρας (8.564; the exact grain of ὀλύρα not certain) | "white barley" · "spelt" | "white barley" · "spelt" | "oats", "wheat", "emmer", "rye" (each decides the grain) |
| ἑσταότες (8.565) | "standing" | "stood" | "waiting", "fixed"; ἵστημι "stand" |
| μίμνω (μίμνον, 8.565) | "were waiting for" | "waited for" | "stood against" (the table’s μίμνον "stand against" is with a foe, 5.94), "remained", "tarried" |
